key_insight: Inserting an ultrathin high work-function metal layer between ITO and NiOx lowers the hole-injection barrier and greatly boosts PeLED luminance.
engineering_relevance: This suggests a simple, scalable anode interlayer strategy to improve carrier injection and output in all-inorganic perovskite LEDs.
method: Simulated the device with drift-diffusion and Poisson equations in Setfos.
Inserted a thin high work-function metal transition layer between ITO and the NiOx hole transport layer.
Compared metals including Au, Pd, and Pt for hole-injection improvement.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that a 2 nm Au interlayer increased luminance by more than 18× in simulation.
watch_item: The result is simulation-based, so real-device fabrication, interfacial stability, and thickness control need experimental verification.
paper_title: Boosting Perovskite Light-Emitting Diodes Performance by Introducing High Work-function Metal Transition Layer
